children: Tata Capital's assets under management are estimated to grow 24% annually through FY 2029, driven by loan growth in core retail and small and medium-sized enterprises, Citi Research's Kunal Shah says in a note. The U.S. bank expects affordable-housing and used-vehicle loans to help widen net interest margins. Tata Capital's entry into gold-backed lending is likely to further aid its retail business, the bank says, adding that Tata Capital has emerged as a scaled, diversified financial franchise. Citi initiates coverage on Tata Capital with a buy rating and a target price of 450.00 rupees. Shares last closed at 341.00 rupees. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
